Change is human work

Human Connection is an organizational consultancy focused on the human side of organizations. From various roles, we guide leaders, teams, and individual professionals to develop and work (together) more proactively.

We always work custom-made, with a broad perspective on people in their context, healthy business operations, and the development of organizational culture.

We are experienced in a wide field, love a complex challenge, and look at possibilities with an optimistic view.

What we stand for

We do what we say and say what we do. Both in how we collaborate internally within our company, and how we collaborate with our clients. We always work:

In Connection

Synergy arises where people are connected with themselves, with each other, and with the purpose of the organization.

Self-awareness, ownership, engagement, and taking responsibility are key here. We stand for this ourselves, and it is also exactly what we help our clients with. We bring our own personalities, experiences, and ‘humanity’ into everything we do.

In Trust

For us, trust is the foundation from which we work. Among ourselves as colleagues and in collaboration with our clients. It is our second nature, wherever we work, to build trust between people and in organizations as a whole.

We approach people and their issues positively: as a principle, we cherish great confidence in everyone’s good intentions, capabilities, and resilience.

In Context

We view every question, no matter how large or small, with a broad perspective. ‘What is really going on here? What patterns are at play?’

Precisely the interplay between various factors (such as organizational structure, way of working, culture, the changing external world) determines success. That is why we closely align with the context of an organization and people, and everything we do is custom-made.

What we do

We approach every issue with an organization-wide perspective. We do this based on several areas of expertise:

Organizational Development & Team Development

We advise and guide teams and organizations during changes. Through longer trajectories (lasting cultural change or reorganizations), shorter interventions (teambuilding and proactive behavior), and ‘everything in between’.

Examples include:

  • Transformation towards more self-management

  • Facilitating in-depth conversations and powerful decision-making.

  • Culture development: better performance and a more (pro)active culture.

  • Reorganizations, mergers, optimizing collaborations

  • Compliance and integrity issues

  • Implementing and guiding Agile/Scrum

Want to know more?
For example, contact Sjef or Zilla.

Contact Sjef

Interim Management

As interim professionals, we become part of the organization for a period. As a manager or director, together with the strategic partners present in the organization, we proactively set a course that aligns with the bigger picture. We enjoy doing this in combination with a change assignment.

We do this, for example, in the areas of:

  • Change management

  • HR management

  • Strategy implementation

  • ICT management

  • L&D Professional

Want to know more?
For example, contact Meggie or Dorothé.

Contact Meggie

Learning & Development

We guide personal and professional development for directors, managers, and professionals. Personal leadership and personal effectiveness are important themes here.

We advise on the most effective approach and design and facilitate workshops or programs such as:

  • Development trajectories and training programs

  • Leadership programs

  • Intervision (Peer consultation)

  • Individual coaching

  • Talent management and trainee programs

  • Designing an effective learning infrastructure

Want to know more?
For example, contact Marit or Annet.
